comment: The rate inputs double the rate per volt, which is the same arithmetic as a pitch input, but they are rate controls and are given the cv family under the rule in STYLE.md. The pitch is capped at 8 before it is raised (src/MentalQuadLFO.cpp:31), so the fastest an oscillator can be driven is 256 cycles a second whatever voltage is patched. In the second mode the three right-hand sliders and all the right-hand jacks are ignored entirely (lines 191-196). In the fifth mode the code tries to re-synchronise the multiplied oscillators by comparing the first oscillator's phase against exactly 0.0 (line 228), a float comparison the running phase will rarely if ever satisfy, so that re-synchronisation should not be relied on. The four phase lamps are created as two-colour lights from PHASE_POS_LIGHT + i (line 276), which makes each of them read the light after it as well, so the lamps overlap; lamps cannot be clicked and get no line. The panel prints Quad LFO, Freq CV, Reset, Sin, Tri, Saw, Sqr and Mode.
